name: Fuenlabrada (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fuenlabrada within a white circle.
history: The flag of Fuenlabrada is formed of two horizontal stripes of equal size, white above representing peace and blue below intended to convey closeness; at the centre is the municipal arms within a white circle, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 10 July 2009. The heraldic arms are used at protocol events and a stylised version for common use.

features.role: Fuenlabrada arms — fountain, castle and rays on blue and red
